request.prompt:
HUD element sheet for a 4-player top-down party brawler, every element laid out separately in a clean grid on a plain neutral warm-grey background, each with a small plain grey caption under it. Draw exactly these elements and nothing else, all text exactly as quoted (Russian):

1. Match timer: big bold white "1:27" with a dark outline. Caption "таймер".
2. Final-seconds timer: big bold red "0:07", slightly larger, and under it a smaller bold red "ФИНАЛ!". Caption "финал".
3. A row of four score tiles side by side, left to right: red 3, blue 23, yellow 1, purple 0. Each tile is a dark rectangular plate with a thin vertical colour strip on its left edge and the number in that player's colour; the blue tile (the leader) has a white frame; the red tile has a small white "ТЫ" in its top-left corner. Caption "счёт, рамка лидера".
4. One line of light-green bold text: "Круг скоро переедет — следующий уже отмечен на газоне". Caption "подсказка круга".
5. Two floating popups in the player's colour: blue "+1 в круге" (smaller) and yellow "ВЫБИЛ! +10" (bigger). Caption "всплывающие".
6. Two red leash segments side by side, straight: a slack one — thin and dark red; a taut one — thick and light red, almost pinkish-white. Caption "поводок: слабый / натянутый".
7. Duel panel: a white round clock "0:42", under it a big score "1 : 0", under it a small light-grey "Раунд 2"; next to it two health bars, each a dark plate with a coloured fill — a red bar three-quarters full and a blue bar one-third full; and a big yellow "Нокаут!" with a dark outline. Caption "дуэль".

No icons, no portraits, no buttons, no minimap, no extra panels or words beyond the quoted ones.

Style direction «Plasticine stop-motion»: every element hand-sculpted from modelling clay — chunky rounded letters rolled from clay with slightly uneven edges and fingerprint dents, a dark clay rim instead of a thin outline; plates are flattened slabs of dark brown-grey clay with soft uneven rounded corners; colour strips, health-bar fills and leash segments are clay sausages and flattened clay strips; matte clay with a faint greasy highlight, warm studio light, soft small shadows under each element; player colours (red, blue, yellow, purple) like clean pieces of clay straight from the box; no gradients, no glow, no outline lines.
request.name: hud
